name: total-agent-memory
description: Persistent local memory for AI coding agents: decisions, solutions, facts and session summaries stored in SQLite on your machine and recalled by hybrid search. Adds the total-agent-memory MCP server and the memory-protocol skill.

interface.shortDescription: Local memory that survives between agent sessions
interface.longDescription: Gives the agent a persistent memory on your machine. The bundled MCP server (uvx total-agent-memory==14.6.0) stores decisions, solutions, facts, lessons, errors and session summaries in a local SQLite database and returns them by hybrid full-text and vector search. The memory-protocol skill tells the agent when to recall and when to save. Nothing is sent to a server run by the author. Requires uv on the machine where Codex runs.
defaultPrompt: Recall what we decided about this project in earlier sessions.
Save the decision we just made and why we made it.
Summarize this session into memory before we stop.
